userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: User account profile and caregiver connection preferences.

id.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified.

userDocument.title: UserDocument
userDocument.description: Historical analyzed document, notice, bill, or form saved by a user.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this document.

title.description: User-facing title or summary label of the document.

documentType.description: Type of official correspondence (e.g., Medicare Notice, Hospital Bill).

urgencyNote.description: Short explanation of the deadline or timing urgency.

originalText.description: Extracted or pasted text of the original document.

inputLanguage.description: Source language code of the input document.

outputLanguage.description: Language code in which the explanation was generated.

nextSteps.description: Array of actionable next steps with completion states.

callScript.description: Word-for-word telephone or office call script.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was analyzed and stored.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user account details and preferences.

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}.description: Stores historical analyzed documents, letters, medical bills, and forms for a user.
